title: Added handling for more SRT handshake extensions. Fixed common display method of sockets to decimal.
description:
1. Added lacking handling for FILTER and GROUP handshake extensions
2. Changed general displaying of the SRT socket value to decimal (generally used in the SRT source code logs)
3. Some cosmetic changes in the column displaying
